role: Read-only primary implementation availability research; no library port or code reuse

findings.actualAppleArmSinf: The reviewed official Apple Libm snapshot has an empty Source/ARM/sinf.s. No usable implementation of the relevant measured arm64 libSystem sinf was identified in that primary snapshot. The nonempty Intel implementation is architecture-specific historical code; neither arithmetic nor licensing is assumed to match current arm64.
findings.portableCandidate: LLVM libc provides sinf with an explicit Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception header and published implementation/dependencies. It is a possible separately qualified portable math enabler, not evidence of equivalence to the measured Apple library.
reuseRisks: Configuration selects FMA and non-FMA evaluation/range-reduction paths.
Float conversion, signed zeros, exceptional values and rounding assumptions need independent browser/host proofs.
A more accurate portable sine is not necessarily bit-identical to Apple sinf and cannot automatically restore the failed native endpoint gate.
findings.decision: Do not implement or emulate Apple libm in this batch. Keep immediate Wave candidate SAW/TRI; default SIN remains unqualified. Future portable math work needs its own source-stage contract, license/attribution preservation and differential corpus.
